name: Sim Says bot API — per-card records
note: Live-graded straights only, $100 flat per bet. Voids are excluded from W-L and P&L. No backtest is blended in. None of these cards is proven — the record decides.

records.description: Our five best findings in one card: CFB totals unders, CFB passing unders, CFB rushing yards, next-man-up starter overs, and NBA underdog fades. The card we post to X each day.
Picks with a moderate edge over the book — no more than 20% — ranked by how likely they are to hit. Up to 5 a day.
Five picks drawn at random from the board each day, as a check — if random beats a method, the method is not doing anything.
Only our two best-tested pick types: college basketball moneylines and NBA assists, where our number and the book's number are close. Up to 5 a day.
Under bets on college football passing yards, chosen where our model leans furthest over the book's number. Up to 5 a day, one pick per game.
Fade the NBA underdog golds: when Model A's >=3c side is the underdog, the favorite is the pick. NBA underdog golds are 3-19 — the edge is that record, not the model's number.
records.note: Fades grade inside Test Card 7 — this is the shared Test Card 7 record, not a fade-only tally.
